WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT zoneref, articount
  FROM scanfeatures
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(articount) AS total_artifacts
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT step1.zoneref, step1.articount,
         1.0 * step1.articount / step2.total_artifacts AS ratio
  FROM step1
  CROSS JOIN step2
  WHERE step2.total_artifacts IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM step3
)
SELECT step3.zoneref, step3.articount, step3.ratio,
       step3.ratio - step4.avg_ratio AS difference
FROM step3
CROSS JOIN step4
WHERE step4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
